capabilities.title: Gene counts per cell
capabilities.conclusion: On 7 datasets (3' v2 and v3, 5', nuclei, mouse, barnyard), Singlet's exonic UMI per cell is 0.98-1.02 of STARsolo Gene's (median ratio; gene correlation 0.962-0.994). Exon+intron counts are 1.02-1.10 of STARsolo GeneFull's (r 0.948-0.987) and 0.92-1.03 of alevin-fry USA's. 36 of 44 gating metrics pass: Singlet sits inside the spread of the competitors, except 8 metrics (see metrics).

capabilities.title: Spliced and unspliced layers
capabilities.conclusion: On 7 datasets Singlet's unspliced UMI per cell is 0.96-1.10 of STARsolo Velocyto's and 0.91-1.05 of alevin-fry USA's (median ratio), and its spliced+ambiguous UMI 1.04-1.32 of STARsolo's; 18 of 42 gating metrics pass (Singlet inside the spread of the two competitors). Spliced and ambiguous alone are defined differently by each tool (ambiguous share: Singlet 0.2%-4.4%, STARsolo 6.5%-10.2%, alevin-fry 32.1%-60.2%) and are not gated.

capabilities.title: Splice junctions and PSI
capabilities.conclusion: On 7 datasets, Singlet's filtered junction set overlaps STARsolo SJ (at defaults) at Jaccard 0.84-0.96, its per-cell junction counts correlate at a median 0.42-0.94 and cassette-exon PSI at r = 0.972-0.999 (pseudobulk). Each is compared with STARsolo in Cell Ranger emulation measured against the same reference; 40 of 42 comparisons pass. Against the Cell Ranger emulation as reference Singlet agrees less (reported, not gated): that filter zeroes some high-count junctions.

capabilities.title: Cell calling
capabilities.conclusion: On 8 datasets Singlet's called_v2 reaches Jaccard 0.83-0.95 with the truth set (recall 0.91-1.00, precision 0.88-0.98), compared with STARsolo EmptyDrops_CR and CellBender; 5 of 25 gating comparisons pass. The 10x truth sets come from Cell Ranger's own EmptyDrops-type call, which STARsolo's EmptyDrops_CR reproduces by construction; only the barnyard species check and the Kang demuxlet table are independent of that algorithm. Singlet loses 20 comparisons (see metrics).

capabilities.title: Non-host (viral and microbial) detection
capabilities.conclusion: Singlet names SARS-CoV-2 in the infected sample and assigns 554,070 reads to it, against 359,472 for Kraken2 (PlusPF) and 488,083 for the minimap2 oracle; per-cell UMIs correlate with the oracle at rho 0.933 (Kraken2 0.829) and separate infected from mock cells at AUROC 0.733 (Kraken2 0.661, ceiling 0.708). In the mock and PBMC samples Singlet calls 0 and 0 species.

capabilities.title: Alignment performance
capabilities.conclusion: Wall time at 16 threads on identical FASTQs (Singlet includes FASTQ encoding and runs the full campaign pipeline): pbmc1k_v3: Singlet 633 s, STARsolo 474 s, alevin-fry 144 s; nuclei2k_v2: Singlet 1,008 s, STARsolo 646 s, alevin-fry 159 s; gsm5815984: Singlet 5,834 s, STARsolo 3,098 s, alevin-fry 967 s. Runtime is shown, not gated. The STAR speedups (sequence cache, lazy window table, huge pages, PGO) leave every count matrix identical; see the optimization table for each speedup measured here.

capabilities.title: SRA download orchestration
capabilities.conclusion: Four concurrent streams of four 10x runs (132 M read pairs): Singlet's orchestrator I/O stage reaches 34 MB/s effective (611,997 read pairs/s) including two read screens, against 15 MB/s for the remote singlet download, 9 for fasterq-dump, 39 for prefetch plus fasterq-dump, 94 for AWS S3 (file only) and 4 for ENA. Completeness is scored against NCBI's decode.

capabilities.title: Hashtag demultiplexing (HTO)
capabilities.conclusion: On the public Howitt et al. 2023 hashing benchmark with genotype truth, Singlet's hashtag calls reach mean F-scores of 0.919, 0.814, 0.752, 0.742 while calling few genetic doublets singlets; it does not beat the best competitor on every batch (see failing metrics).

capabilities.title: Cell type labels
capabilities.conclusion: On 16 held-out studies with curated cell types (291,331 cells), with every tool trained on the same CELLxGENE reference, Singlet labels 74.4% of cells with the right lineage against 67.1% for CellTypist, 72.9% for scANVI, 62.7% for Seurat, 70.8% for SingleR. Its calibrated call cuts wrong calls to 25.1%.

capabilities.title: Chromosomal sex per cell
capabilities.conclusion: On 171 samples with sex in their GEO metadata (472,363 cells), Singlet labels 97.0% of cells with their sample's recorded sex, against 68.0% for cellXY, 50.6% for xist-chrY-rule.
